# Brookings Institution

> > A leading independent think tank producing rigorous policy research and analysis on economics, foreign policy, governance, and domestic challenges.

Brookings Institution is a nonprofit, nonpartisan policy research organization based in Washington, DC, featuring expert researchers, centers focused on key policy areas, and a robust calendar of public events and forums. The site provides access to research programs, expert directories, policy analysis, and opportunities for media engagement and financial support.

## Key Topics

- Economic Studies
- Foreign Policy
- Governance Studies
- Policy Analysis
- Research Fellows
- Expert Directory
- Global Economy and Development
- Center for Middle East Policy
- Strobe Talbott Center for Security, Strategy, and Technology
- Center for Asia Policy Studies
- Public Policy
- Think Tank
- Policy Forums
- Expert Discussions
- Brookings Metro

## Research & Expertise

- [Research Programs](https://www.brookings.edu/research-programs): Overview of Brookings research centers: Economic Studies, Foreign Policy, Governance Studies.
- [Experts Directory](https://www.brookings.edu/experts): Directory of Brookings experts including Henry Aaron, Rohit Acharya, and other research fellows.
- [Topics & Research Areas](https://www.brookings.edu/topics): Navigation hub organizing Brookings research by policy areas and subject categories.

## Events & Engagement

- [Events Calendar](https://www.brookings.edu/events): Calendar of Brookings policy forums and expert discussions on economics, security, and governance.
- [Newsletters](https://www.brookings.edu/newsletters): Subscription management for Brookings Brief, Economic Studies Bulletin, and other newsletters.
- [For Media](https://www.brookings.edu/for-media): Media resources: expert interviews, press releases, TV studio access for journalists.

## Policy Research Areas

- [Immigration & Integration](https://www.brookings.edu/topics/immigration-5): Brookings research on immigration policy, immigrant integration, and socioeconomic impacts.
- [Housing & Urban Policy](https://www.brookings.edu/topics/housing): Brookings expert insights on housing policy, affordability, urban planning, and climate risk.
- [Business & Workforce](https://www.brookings.edu/topics/business-industry): Brookings analysis of labor policy, entrepreneurship, automation, and workforce development.
- [Iran & Middle East](https://www.brookings.edu/regions/middle-east-north-africa/iran): Brookings analysis of Iran's nuclear program, Middle East role, and energy security.

## Organization

- [Leadership](https://www.brookings.edu/about-us/leadership): Brookings leadership team including President Cecilia Elena Rouse and executive officers.
- [Support Brookings](https://www.brookings.edu/support-brookings): Donation and fundraising page for supporting Brookings independent research and policy work.

## Optional

- [Financial Transparency](https://www.brookings.edu/about-us/finances): Financial transparency and nonprofit accountability reporting for Brookings Institution.
